description.narrative: IFC invested THB62.7 million in the inaugural Blue Bond issued by Eastern Water Resources Development and Management Public Company Limited (East Water or the Company) on 18 August 2025. The total issuance size was THB620 million. IFCs subscription will be applied to refinance part of the Company's existing funding incurred to mainly finance the construction of the water transmission pipelines in Rayong and Chonburi, which was completed in October 2024 (the Project).

IFC is providing debt refinancing at competitive terms for East Water to ensure its operation continues as usual, as the largest private sector company supplying water (including potable water) in Eastern Economic Corridor (EEC). The investment will help free up cash flows for East Water to continue investing in maintaining its system. By ensuring the continuity of East Waters business operations, the Project is expected to increase access to water supply and enhance peoples resilience to climate risk caused by climate change and natural hazards by ensuring tap water supply to residents. In addition, by diversifying the water sources used for supply and providing a reliable water supply service, the Project is expected to increase the resilience of the water sector in Thailand, and in the EEC more specifically, where water demand is expected to grow.
